subject: DPA & Pen-test kickoff — timezone alignment
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@starlift.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: DPA & Pen-test kickoff — alignment call

Hi Aditya and Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Starlift is preparing to start a combined DPA review + pen-test kickoff for our upcoming integration with Redwood. We want to run a short joint session to: (1) align on the DPA data flows and retention expectations, (2) walk through the SOC 2 artifact mapping at a high level, and (3) confirm pen-test scope and timelines.

Would either of these work on your side?
- Tue Apr 21, 10:00–11:00 ET (EDT)
- Wed Apr 22, 14:00–15:00 CET

We expect ~45 minutes. I've attached our initial questionnaire to this note. Please include whoever owns SOC 2 evidence and the engineering lead who will own the pen-test coordination.

Looking forward —
Maria

[Attachment: starlift-security-questions.pdf (PDF)]
Maria Gonzalez
Senior Security Program Manager | Starlift Retail
maria.gonzalez@starlift.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@starlift.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: DPA & Pen-test kickoff — alignment call

Hi Maria — thanks for sending this over and for the clear list. We can definitely do a combined session; makes sense to consolidate so the teams have the same context.

Quick notes:
- Vanessa will own the evidence walkthrough (SOC 2/controls map).
- Priyom (cc'ed) will represent eng for pen-test scope and test-owner handoff.

If it helps, here's a Calendly link showing our available 45-min windows this week and next: https://calendly.com/redwood/dpa-pen-test-45m. To make scheduling easier across time zones, we can also propose the following concrete options in UTC:
- Apr 21, 14:00–14:45 UTC (10:00 ET)
- Apr 22, 12:00–12:45 UTC (14:00 CET)

If those still don't work, happy to shift to the week of Apr 25 — tell us a few slots that work for your engineering lead and we'll align.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@starlift.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Samuel Cho <samuel.cho@starlift.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: DPA & Pen-test kickoff — alignment call

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the options. Unfortunately both of those windows conflict for our eng lead. He asked if we can move this to the week of Apr 25; he has the following availability (all times Europe CEST):
- Tue Apr 26, 10:00–11:00 CEST
- Wed Apr 27, 14:00–15:00 CEST

Either of those would work as a 45-minute joint call. Also looping in Sam (cc) from engineering.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will join (names + roles) and whether you'll be able to share a short evidence mapping doc ahead of the call? That will help Sam prepare.

Thanks,
Maria

- Tue Apr 26, 08:00–08:45 ET / 12:00–12:45 UTC / 14:00–14:45 CEST
